Supergirl Movie Reviews Highlight Mixed Reception for DC Adventure

The new "Supergirl" movie, starring Milly Alcock, has received varied reviews from critics. While some outlets praised Alcock's performance and the film's wit, others criticized the writing and overall execution. Reviewers generally agree that the film is a DC adventure, with some noting its visual aspects.
